verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੫ : ਤੀਰਥਾਂ ਪਰ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ-ਭਾਵ ਦੀ ਘਾਟ
verses.translit_en: pauRee 25 : teerathaa(n) par prema-bhaav dhee ghaaT

en.bdb: Lack of love and affection at pilgrim centres

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਆਇਆ ਤੀਰਥੈ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਸਭੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: baabaa aaiaa teerathai teerath purab sabhe fir dhekhai|

en.bdb: Baba (Nanak) came to the pilgrimage centres and by participating in the ceremonies there he observed them minutely.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਬ ਧਰਮਿ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: purab dharam bahu karam kar bhaau bhagat bin kitai na lekhai|

en.bdb: People were busy in performing the rituals of the ceremonies but since being bereft of loving devotion, they were of no avail.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਚਾਰਿ ਬੇਦ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੜ੍ਹਿ ਪੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: bhaau na brahamai likhiaa chaar bedh si(n)mirat paReh pekhai|

en.bdb: Having gone through the Vedas and simritis one finds that Brahma also has nowhere written about the Sentiment of love.

verses.gurmukhi: ਢੂੰਡੀ ਸਗਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਵੀ ਸਤਿਜੁਗਿ ਆਦਿ ਦੁਆਪਰਿ ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ।
verses.translit_en: ddoo(n)ddee sagalee pirathavee satijug aadh dhuaapar tretai|

en.bdb: To find out the same, the satyug, treta dvapar etc. have been screened.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਧੰੁਧੂਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਭੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: kalijug dha(n)udhookaar hai bharam bhulaiee bahu bidh bhekhai|

en.bdb: In kaliyug, the pitch darkness prevails in which many guises and hypocritical ways have been started.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭੇਖੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਰੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: bhekhee prabhoo na paieeaai aap gavaae roop na rekhai|

en.bdb: Through garbs and guises one cannot reach the Lord; He can be reached through self-effacement.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਰਨੁ ਅਵਰਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਵਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਿ ਵਿਸੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh varan avaran hoi niv chalanaa gursikh visekhai|

en.bdb: The special feature of the Sikh of the Guru is that he goes beyond the framework of caste-classification and moves in humility.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਘਾਲਿ ਪਵੈ ਦਰਿ ਲੇਖੈ ॥੨੫॥
verses.translit_en: taa kichh ghaal pavai dhar lekhai ||25||

en.bdb: Then his toilsome labour becomes acceptable at the door (of the Lord).
